title: The merge tool's review-record post runs the hook catalog check on the head and refuses to post on red
why: A stale hook catalog reaches the batch with a review record on it, and CI then turns the whole batch red.
note: Run `python3 lint/hook_catalog.py --check` on the head, as the post now runs ste-lint (decision ste-lint-at-push). Incident: #1687 got a review record and went to runner 8 with the catalog check red (coordinator, 19:36 CST Nov 7). Given to lane lint-before-record-push, still open, 19:36 CST; status todo until the lane starts it. Premise fixed (19:38 CST): on main, merge --review-record runs no lint, and decision ste-lint-at-push (branch lint-before-record-push) runs the STE lint at git push, not at the record post. The lane proposes the existing home merge --lane-lint (ci-job checks --lint), with its step pick to include `Hook catalog check` (checks.yml:360). It waits on the coordinator's pick of the home. The coordinator picked merge --lane-lint as the home; the lane started it on branch record-push-runs-catalog-check, red tests first (19:38 CST).
